name: com.figuredeck/conforming-limits
title: FigureDeck US Mortgage Data
description: 2026 US conforming loan limits for 3,235 counties, plus mortgage payment and affordability math

tools.name: search_conforming_limits
tools.description: Look up the FHFA conforming loan limit for a US county in calendar year 2026 — the maximum loan Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac will buy, for 1- to 4-unit properties. Covers all 3235 counties and county equivalents. Returns the baseline for counties with no special designation, and flags the 160 high-cost counties whose limit is above it. Pass a county name, a 5-digit FIPS code, or a state to list its counties.

county.description: County name, with or without 'County'/'Parish' and state, e.g. 'King County, WA' or 'king'.

fips.description: 5-digit county FIPS, e.g. '53033'. Takes precedence over county.

state.description: Two-letter state code, e.g. 'WA'. Filters results; on its own, lists that state's counties.

tools.name: mortgage_payment
tools.description: Fixed-rate, fully amortising mortgage: equal monthly payment of principal and interest. Returns the monthly P&I, the lifetime interest, the total paid, and what share of the first payment is interest. Optionally adds monthly property tax, insurance and HOA to the total. Use this instead of estimating: the payment is exact to the cent and matches the calculator on figuredeck.com.

loan_amount.description: Amount borrowed in dollars — the price minus the down payment, not the price.

annual_rate_percent.description: Nominal annual interest rate in percent, e.g. 6.5 for 6.5%.

monthly_tax.description: Optional monthly property tax in dollars.

monthly_insurance.description: Optional monthly homeowners insurance in dollars.

monthly_hoa.description: Optional monthly HOA or condo dues in dollars.

tools.name: affordability
tools.description: Works backwards from income to a purchase price. Applies a debt-to-income cap to gross monthly income, subtracts existing monthly debts, then subtracts property tax, insurance and HOA, and solves for the loan that the remaining monthly budget supports at the given rate. Adds the down payment to get the price. Also returns the same answer at the 28%, 36%, 43% and 50% DTI caps so the caller can see how much the choice of cap moves the number.

monthly_income.description: Gross monthly income in dollars. Monthly, not annual — divide by 12 first.

annual_rate_percent.description: Expected nominal annual rate in percent, e.g. 6.5.

monthly_debts.description: Existing monthly debt payments (car, student, cards) in dollars. Default 0.

down_payment.description: Cash available for down payment in dollars. Default 0.

dti_cap_percent.description: Which DTI cap to headline. Default 36.

monthly_tax.description: Optional monthly property tax in dollars.

monthly_insurance.description: Optional monthly homeowners insurance in dollars.
